# Auto-generated by ForgeFlow
import asyncio
import os
import time
from datetime import datetime

import httpx

TARGET_URL = os.getenv('TARGET_URL', 'https://example.com')
SLACK_BOT_TOKEN = os.getenv('SLACK_BOT_TOKEN', '')
SLACK_CHANNEL = os.getenv('SLACK_NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL', '#forgeflow-alerts')
GOOGLE_API_KEY = os.getenv('GOOGLE_API_KEY', '')
GOOGLE_SHEET_ID = os.getenv('GOOGLE_SHEET_ID', '')

async def check_website_health(context):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10, follow_redirects=True) as client:
        response = await client.get(TARGET_URL)
    latency_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000, 2)
    ok = 200 <= response.status_code < 400
    result = {'ok': ok, 'url': TARGET_URL, 'status_code': response.status_code, 'latency_ms': latency_ms}
    context['step_1'] = result
    return result

async def send_slack_alert(context):
    health = context.get('step_1', {})
    if health.get('ok'):
        return {'ok': True, 'skipped': True, 'reason': 'site healthy'}
    if not SLACK_BOT_TOKEN:
        return {'ok': False, 'error': 'SLACK_BOT_TOKEN not configured'}
    text = f"Website health check failed: {health.get('url')} returned {health.get('status_code')}"
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
        response = await client.post('https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {SLACK_BOT_TOKEN}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, json={'channel': SLACK_CHANNEL, 'text': text})
    return {'ok': response.json().get('ok', False)}

async def log_to_sheets(context):
    health = context.get('step_1', {})
    if not GOOGLE_API_KEY or not GOOGLE_SHEET_ID:
        return {'ok': False, 'error': 'Google Sheets not configured'}
    values = [[datetime.utcnow().isoformat(), health.get('url'), health.get('status_code'), health.get('latency_ms')]]
    url = f'https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/{GOOGLE_SHEET_ID}/values/Sheet1!A:D:append'
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as client:
        response = await client.post(url, params={'valueInputOption': 'USER_ENTERED', 'key': GOOGLE_API_KEY}, json={'values': values})
    return {'ok': response.status_code < 400}

async def main():
    context = {}
    await check_website_health(context)
    await asyncio.gather(send_slack_alert(context), log_to_sheets(context))
    print('Workflow complete', context)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
